command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
# QM9 (Ramakrishnan et al., Sci. Data 1, 140022; figshare collection 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.978904),
# fetched on AWS and checked against the md5 figshare computed for each file before it is kept.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
import hashlib, urllib.request
F = [("3195389", "dsgdb9nsd.xyz.tar.bz2", "ad1ebd51ee7f5b3a6e32e974e5d54012"),
     ("3195398", "dsC7O2H10nsd.xyz.tar.bz2", "c750c9f3832e6f63ad64bfb3bd12a045"),
     ("3195404", "uncharacterized.txt", "a361887bacb427b8a0ce7903d92a53b4"),
     ("3195395", "atomref.txt", "2d30b2df8329d8fd805c0a4d158a0a0f"),
     ("3195401", "validation.txt", "7f356bccd797af35e4e54b783ac7d79d"),
     ("3195392", "readme.txt", "c6581a03f673746528c57acfc6b79679")]
for fid, name, md5 in F:
    m = hashlib.md5()
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/" + fid, headers={"User-Agent": "curl/8"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600) as r, open(name, "wb") as fh:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b:
                break
            m.update(b); fh.write(b)
    print(name, "md5", m.hexdigest(), "figshare", md5)
    assert m.hexdigest() == md5, name + ": md5 does not match figshare's computed_md5"
PYEOF
sha256sum *.bz2 *.txt | tee qm9.sha256
ls -l
echo DONE
